extras: The plugin operates on a freemium model, offering free use with quotas and requiring external tools like FFmpeg and yt-dlp for full functionality.
intentEvidence: Clip2MD turns web pages, WeChat shares, images and documents into searchable Markdown knowledge.
problem: Capturing and organizing ephemeral web content and digital snippets into a permanent, searchable knowledge base within Obsidian.
summary: Clip2MD converts web pages, WeChat shares, images, and documents into searchable Markdown knowledge and sync them to Obsidian.
